title: Runtime-aligned RCB export and smoother COMTRADE interaction
titleId: Export RCB selaras runtime dan interaksi COMTRADE lebih halus
summary: ARSAS 1.6.37 is a focused reliability and UX update for Legacy SAS RCB export and the in-process COMTRADE workstation. Live RCB instances are presented as concrete runtime slots exposed by the connected IED while source-backed IID/SCL export keeps the canonical logical ReportControl identity, and COMTRADE Phasor, Harmonics and distance Locus presentation now follows native analysis targets smoothly without changing authoritative engineering values.
summaryId: ARSAS 1.6.37 adalah pembaruan reliability dan UX yang terfokus untuk export RCB Legacy SAS dan workstation COMTRADE in-process. Instance RCB live ditampilkan sebagai slot runtime konkret yang benar-benar diekspos oleh IED terhubung sementara export IID/SCL source-backed tetap mempertahankan identity logical ReportControl yang canonical, dan presentation COMTRADE Phasor, Harmonics, serta distance Locus kini mengikuti target native analysis secara lebih halus tanpa mengubah nilai engineering yang authoritative.
highlights: Legacy SAS RCB selection now presents concrete live instances such as Buffer01/Buffer02 and Unbuffer01/Unbuffer02 when those instances are actually exposed by the connected IED, without showing a duplicate logical Buffer/Unbuffer row.
Source-backed RCB export preserves the canonical SCL ReportControl identity and RptEnabled indexing metadata, keeping online runtime instances separate from the saved engineering model.

RCB occupancy is shown with a calm square-only indicator: yellow when a client is using the RCB and green otherwise, while detailed engineering evidence remains available without alarming status captions.
COMTRADE Phasor and Harmonics views ease toward the latest exact native result at display cadence, with bounded settle time and exact convergence to the authoritative analysis target.

Distance Locus cursor presentation now uses the same latest-target principle and resets transient presentation state across PRI/SEC engineering-basis changes so unrelated unit bases are never interpolated together.
highlightsId: Pemilihan RCB Legacy SAS kini menampilkan instance live konkret seperti Buffer01/Buffer02 dan Unbuffer01/Unbuffer02 ketika instance tersebut benar-benar diekspos oleh IED yang terhubung, tanpa menampilkan row logical Buffer/Unbuffer duplikat.

Export RCB source-backed mempertahankan identity SCL ReportControl canonical dan metadata indexing RptEnabled, dengan pemisahan yang jelas antara instance runtime online dan engineering model tersimpan.

Occupancy RCB ditampilkan dengan indikator kotak yang tenang: kuning ketika RCB sedang digunakan client dan hijau untuk kondisi lainnya, sementara evidence engineering detail tetap tersedia tanpa caption status yang mengkhawatirkan.
View COMTRADE Phasor dan Harmonics melakukan easing menuju hasil native exact terbaru pada display cadence, dengan settle time terbatas dan konvergensi exact ke target analysis authoritative.

Presentation cursor Distance Locus kini memakai prinsip latest-target yang sama dan mereset transient presentation state saat basis engineering PRI/SEC berubah sehingga unit basis yang berbeda tidak pernah diinterpolasikan bersama.
improvements: The RCB source/export boundary is regression-guarded so declarative RptEnabled@max metadata never becomes authority to invent runtime RCB names.
Live-model-only RCB export remains concrete and unchanged; canonical source identity preservation is opt-in only for source-backed SCL export.
COMTRADE presentation smoothing does not add an analysis queue or periodic work after settling: cursor/native analysis remains latest-wins and authoritative.

The stable Windows release pipeline runs full application regressions, RCB and COMTRADE integration guards, portable and installer smoke tests, SHA-256 checksums, SPDX SBOM, provenance and GitHub attestations before publication.
improvementsId: Boundary source/export RCB dikunci regression test sehingga metadata deklaratif RptEnabled@max tidak pernah menjadi authority untuk menciptakan nama RCB runtime.
Export RCB live-model-only tetap concrete dan tidak berubah; preservation identity source canonical hanya diaktifkan untuk export SCL source-backed.
Smoothing presentation COMTRADE tidak menambah analysis queue maupun kerja periodik setelah settle: cursor/native analysis tetap latest-wins dan authoritative.

Pipeline stable release Windows menjalankan regression test aplikasi lengkap, guard integrasi RCB dan COMTRADE, smoke test portable dan installer, checksum SHA-256, SPDX SBOM, provenance, serta GitHub attestation sebelum publikasi.
knownLimitations: Physical relay validation remains necessary for vendor-specific values, report behavior and field network conditions that cannot be reproduced by CI.
Windows x64 is the only packaged desktop platform in this stable release.
The public binaries are not Authenticode code-signed; Windows SmartScreen may show an unrecognized-publisher warning.
Raw-Ethernet GOOSE and Sampled Values workflows require an administrator-installed and approved Npcap driver, suitable capture permission and visibility of the relevant multicast traffic.
knownLimitationsId: Validasi relay fisik tetap diperlukan untuk value vendor-specific, perilaku report, dan kondisi network lapangan yang tidak dapat direproduksi oleh CI.
Windows x64 adalah satu-satunya platform desktop yang dipaketkan pada stable release ini.
Binary publik belum ditandatangani dengan Authenticode; Windows SmartScreen dapat menampilkan peringatan unrecognized publisher.
Workflow raw-Ethernet GOOSE dan Sampled Values memerlukan driver Npcap yang telah dipasang dan disetujui administrator, capture permission yang sesuai, serta visibility traffic multicast terkait.

codeSigning.label: Not Authenticode-signed
codeSigning.detail: The current public Windows installer and portable binaries do not carry a commercial Authenticode publisher signature. Verify the published SHA-256 value before use. SmartScreen warnings are therefore possible and are not hidden from users.
codeSigning.detailId: Installer Windows dan portable EXE publik saat ini belum memiliki commercial Authenticode publisher signature. Verifikasi nilai SHA-256 yang dipublikasikan sebelum digunakan. Karena itu peringatan SmartScreen masih mungkin muncul dan status ini tidak disembunyikan dari user.
